I will apply fertilizer to this barley plot because the soil here in Oromia needs it for a good harvest, and I was able to get DAP and urea from the cooperative. I also spread manure from my animals, and I will use my own seed that I kept from last season. My family can manage all the work on this small plot ourselves, so I do not need to hire anyone. We have no irrigation water here, and barley does not need spraying with chemicals.
